kashika: स्वतन्त्र इति प्रधानभूत उच्यते, अगुणभूतः। यः क्रियासिद्धौ स्वातन्त्र्येण विवक्ष्यते, तत् कारकं कर्तृसंज्ञं भवति। देवदत्तः पचति। स्थाली पचति। कर्तृप्रदेशाः — <<कर्तृकरणयोस्तृतीया>> [[२.३.१८]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: The independent, principal source of action chosen by the speaker is kartā (agent).
englishFull:
That which the speaker conceives as the independent source of action is called कर्तृ (agent).

The agent is "self-dependent" (स्वतन्त्र) — not subordinate to another in performing the action.

**Examples:**
- देवदत्तः पचति "Devadatta cooks" — Devadatta is कर्तृ
- स्थाली पचति "The pot cooks" — even the pot can be कर्तृ if conceived as independent

**Key point:** कर्तृ is determined by the speaker's conception, not objective reality.
